description: This file contains JavaScript functions for UI interactions in the Spark web UI, including table row styling, toggling thread stack traces, search filtering, and collapsing/expanding table sections.

methods.name: stripeSummaryTable
methods.description: Adds background colors to stripe table rows in the summary table for visual clarity.

methods.name: toggleThreadStackTrace
methods.description: Toggles the display of a thread's stack trace in the UI.

methods.name: expandAllThreadStackTrace
methods.description: Expands all thread stack traces in the UI.

methods.name: collapseAllThreadStackTrace
methods.description: Collapses all thread stack traces in the UI.

methods.name: onMouseOverAndOut
methods.description: Handles mouse over and out events for thread ID elements to toggle highlight classes.

methods.name: onSearchStringChange
methods.description: Filters thread rows based on search input.

methods.name: collapseTableAndButton
methods.description: Collapses a table and toggles the visibility of its associated button.
